title: 10 Day Japan Itinerary for First-Time Visitors (2026)
description: The complete 10-day Japan itinerary for first timers: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka day-by-day with budget breakdowns, JR Pass advice, and insider tips from real travelers.

days.title: Day Trip — Nature, Temples & Mt. Fuji
days.description: You have two excellent options. Choose based on your interests:

days.neighborhoods: Fushimi Inari · Kiyomizu-dera · Gion · Nishiki Market
days.title: Eastern Kyoto — Gates, Geisha & Street Food
days.description: Take the shinkansen from Tokyo Station to Kyoto Station (Nozomi: 2 hours 15 minutes, ¥13,320; Hikari: 2 hours 40 minutes, covered by JR Pass). Base yourself near Kyoto Station, Gion/Higashiyama, or along the Karasuma Line for easy subway access.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
activities.description: The iconic tunnel of 10,000+ vermilion torii gates. Arrive by 7:00 AM (it's open 24/7) to experience it without crowds. The full hike to the summit takes 2–3 hours; most visitors walk 30–45 minutes to the Yotsutsuji intersection viewpoint and turn back.

activities.name: Kiyomizu-dera & Higashiyama
activities.description: Take the Keihan Line to Kiyomizu-dera Temple (¥400). Walk through the atmospheric streets of Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka — preserved Edo-period lanes with tea houses and pottery shops. Try yatsuhashi (cinnamon rice cake, Kyoto's signature sweet).

days.title: Western Kyoto — Bamboo, Gold & Riverside Dining
Day Trip to Nara — Deer, Giant Buddha & Ancient Shrines
Osaka — Food Capital of Japan
days.description: Getting there from Kyoto: JR Special Rapid to Osaka Station (30 minutes, ¥570) or Hankyu Line to Umeda (45 minutes, ¥400). Base yourself in Namba or Shinsaibashi — walking distance to Dotonbori.
